description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Odyssey (org.gateshipone.odyssey), version F-Droid build 42.

features.name: Browse the music library by album
features.description: Browse the music library by album as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap the "Albums" tab in My Music
tap an album to open its track list

features.name: Browse the music library by artist
features.description: Browse the music library by artist as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap an album to see its tracks

features.name: Browse all tracks
features.description: Browse all tracks as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap a track to play it

features.name: Browse recently added albums
features.description: Browse recently added albums as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap an album to open or play it

features.name: Browse the file system with the file browser
features.description: Browse the file system with the file browser as documented for Odyssey.
actions: navigate the folders on the device
tap an audio file to play it, or use the folder action to play or enqueue the whole folder

features.name: Play a track
features.description: Play a track as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Tap a track in any list
playback starts and the now-playing bar appears at the bottom
drag the bar upwards to open the full player

features.name: Control playback from the full player
features.description: Control playback from the full player as documented for Odyssey.
actions: drag the seek bar to move within the track
tap the down arrow to collapse the player

features.name: Use repeat and shuffle
features.description: Use repeat and shuffle as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap the repeat icon to cycle through off, repeat all and repeat one
tap the shuffle icon to toggle random playback

features.name: View and edit the play queue
features.description: View and edit the play queue as documented for Odyssey.
actions: drag an item to reorder it
swipe an item away to remove it
tap an item to jump to it

features.name: Add an album, artist or track to the queue
features.description: Add an album, artist or track to the queue as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Long-press the item (or tap its overflow menu)
the selection is appended to or inserted into the queue

features.name: Clear the play queue
features.description: Clear the play queue as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Open the full player or the queue view

features.name: Save the current queue as a playlist
features.description: Save the current queue as a playlist as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Open the full player or queue view

features.name: Browse and play saved playlists
features.description: Browse and play saved playlists as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap a playlist to see its tracks
tap a track to play from that playlist, or use the overflow menu to play or enqueue the whole playlist

features.name: Delete a playlist
features.description: Delete a playlist as documented for Odyssey.

features.name: Create a bookmark to resume an audiobook or podcast
features.description: Create a bookmark to resume an audiobook or podcast as documented for Odyssey.
actions: open the full player or the overflow menu
tap OK; the current queue and playback position are stored

features.name: Resume from a bookmark
features.description: Resume from a bookmark as documented for Odyssey.
actions: the saved queue is restored and playback resumes from the stored position

features.name: Delete a bookmark
features.description: Delete a bookmark as documented for Odyssey.

features.name: Search the library
features.description: Search the library as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
review the matching artists, albums and tracks
tap a result to play or open it

features.name: Jump from a track to its album or artist
features.description: Jump from a track to its album or artist as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Long-press a track (or open the player overflow menu)

features.name: View track and album information
features.description: View track and album information as documented for Odyssey.
actions: read the title, artist, album, track number, duration and file path

features.name: Download artwork for artists and albums
features.description: Download artwork for artists and albums as documented for Odyssey.
actions: choose the artwork provider (Fanart.tv, Last.fm or MusicBrainz)
optionally tap the bulk download action to fetch the missing images

features.name: Clear the artwork cache
features.description: Clear the artwork cache as documented for Odyssey.
actions: tap the "Clear image cache"/clear artwork action

features.name: Restrict artwork downloads to Wi-Fi
features.description: Restrict artwork downloads to Wi-Fi as documented for Odyssey.

features.name: Control playback from the lock screen and the notification
features.description: Control playback from the lock screen and the notification as documented for Odyssey.
actions: pull down the notification shade or wake the lock screen
use the play/pause, previous, next and stop controls shown with the album art

features.name: Add the Odyssey home screen widget
features.description: Add the Odyssey home screen widget as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the widget onto the home screen
use its controls to play, pause and skip without opening the app

features.name: Scrobble to Last.fm through a scrobbler app
features.description: Scrobble to Last.fm through a scrobbler app as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Install a compatible scrobbler such as Simple Last.fm Scrobbler
configure it with the Last.fm account
play music in Odyssey; the track changes are broadcast and scrobbled automatically

features.name: Open the system equaliser
features.description: Open the system equaliser as documented for Odyssey.
actions: Open the navigation drawer or the player overflow menu
the system audio effects panel opens

features.name: Change the theme
features.description: Change the theme as documented for Odyssey.
actions: choose one of the Material colour themes and the light, dark or OLED-black variant
the app restarts the view with the new theme

features.name: Change the library view style
features.description: Change the library view style as documented for Odyssey.
actions: choose whether albums and artists are shown as a grid or as a list

features.name: Change the album and track sort order
features.description: Change the album and track sort order as documented for Odyssey.
actions: choose the ordering (for example by name or by year)

features.name: Configure playback behaviour
features.description: Configure playback behaviour as documented for Odyssey.
actions: set the resume step size for the seek controls, the behaviour on headphone disconnect and the hardware media-button handling

features.name: Rescan the media library
features.description: Rescan the media library as documented for Odyssey.
actions: wait for the Android media scanner to finish
the new files appear in the lists

features.name: View the about screen and licences
features.description: View the about screen and licences as documented for Odyssey.
actions: read the version number, the source repository link and the GPL licence information
